provenance.recovered: point estimates read from the producer's per-value log output; the run was trimmed after the decisive pair (v=0.0, v=0.25) completed and before v=0.5, so the producer's final JSON with bootstrap intervals was not written. The numbers below are the producer's own printed recall, not re-typed measurements of anything else.
provenance.generator: artifacts/full5000_implicit (deployed), match_scale overridden at inference; candidate set and filter scores unchanged, only the generator score and thus the ranking move
provenance.ranking: the release order (dedup by tautomer key, cap 100 by generator, reciprocal rank fusion, parent dropped)
provenance.bootstrap: not computed (trimmed before the final pass); deltas are read against the seed-to-seed sd 0.0107 at k=15 from results/retraining_spread.json

reproduces_deployed_arm.note: the regenerated deployed arm (match_scale 0.25) reproduces the registered validation recall of 0.4748 to within 0.0015, which certifies the regeneration is on the deployed model; the delta between match_scale values is internally consistent within this one pipeline

reading: removing the multiplicity bonus entirely (match_scale 0.0) lifts recall at the head (k=1, k=5) and is flat to fractionally lower at the reported budget (k=15); every delta is well inside the seed-to-seed sd of 0.0107, so the generator-score lever, like the representation and filter levers, moves along the head-vs-depth frontier rather than raising it
